shots.action: A shimmer of gold spreads from the subject's hands across their whole body, skin, hair and clothes hardening into polished metal until they stand perfectly still as a gold statue.
shots.sound: A soft metallic crackle rising into a bright ringing chime.

end.paint: Turn the person into a solid polished gold statue: skin, hair and clothes are all gleaming gold metal with fine sculpted detail. Keep the same person, face, pose, framing, background and lighting.
